big_case.notes: Section 11 misleading-omissions liability for undisclosed interim (intra-quarter) IPO financial data: a recurring, commercially important securities-disclosure question from the circuit that hears much IPO litigation, with Chamber/SIFMA/WLF amicus support, a CVSG, and an SG recommendation to grant. The Court granted limited to the first question. Significant for issuers, underwriters and the securities bar; technical and of little general-public salience, so above the median granted case in its field but well short of a headline case.
